messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): Waiting Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits
Replaced rule (2020): Additional waiting period shall not exceed forty‑eight months for undisclosed conditions
Existing questions: ['What is the maximum waiting period I can expect for a claim under the new IRDAI rules?', 'Are waiting periods still limited to 48 months as per the older circular, or have they changed?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["I just bought a health insurance policy this month; how many days of waiting should I expect before I can claim for a new illness under the current IRDAI guidelines?","My doctor diagnosed me with a condition that wasn't listed when I bought the policy. Under the 2024 rules, what is the waiting period in days before I can receive benefits?"]}
